generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Build executable or deployable services, packages, containers, workflow bundles, and deployment configuration.

contract.purpose_user_function: Construct executable/deployable services, packages, containers, workflow bundles, and deployment configuration.
contract.valid_inputs: Verified source/artifacts, runtime/dependency manifest, target platform, package/container/workflow spec, configuration/secrets references, health checks, and release criteria.
contract.expected_outputs: Package/service/container/workflow bundle, install/deploy config, manifest/hashes, smoke/health evidence, and rollback instructions.
contract.state_side_effects: Builds package/container/bundle and may install/deploy only to approved isolated/target environments.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Build failure, missing dependency, secret inclusion, platform mismatch, failed smoke/health, unsafe deploy, or missing rollback blocks delivery.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Installer, distribution/pipx, Dockerfile, launchd and workflow artifacts exist; no universal runtime-deliverable builder covers all targets.
contract.success_evidence: Artifact installs/starts in clean sandbox, health/smoke passes, manifest excludes secrets, and uninstall/rollback is documented and verified.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: package; container; workflow bundle; install smoke; platform mismatch; secret scan; health; rollback.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
